criteria.GDN-077-AC01: Only a committed full size/hash/header verification creates a quarantine reference. Partial, paused, revoked, interrupted or expired sessions expose no accepted source.
criteria.GDN-077-AC02: Authenticated subject/workspace/source binding is checked before storage access and at current audited gates; takeover and changed-manifest replays reject.
criteria.GDN-077-AC03: Each part and assembled original are rehashed; the GDN-045 handoff rechecks original bytes and the reviewed schema independently. Malware and historical/rights review remain unperformed.
criteria.GDN-077-AC04: Byte-identical completed sources are reported only to the same owner and workspace after full verification. No other contributor or workspace identity leaks through duplicate receipts.

test_ids.GDN-077-T01: Out-of-order parts, pause/resume, durable reopen, exact replay, actual subprocess SIGKILL before chunk/finalize commit and successful recovery.
test_ids.GDN-077-T02: Per-part/whole digest, MIME header, body/source limits, reservation/session/in-flight quotas, corrupted stored bytes, unsafe modes and symlinks.
test_ids.GDN-077-T03: Owner/workspace takeover, disabled capability, current source grants, identity changes, cancellation, commit-time revocation and durable audit failures.
test_ids.GDN-077-T04: Same-owner content duplicate receipt, denied cross-contributor/workspace duplicate disclosure and rejection of contradictory receipt states.

activation: Default-disabled unmounted service, offline repository and read-only receipt component. No provider upload or mounted HTTP endpoint.
limitations: Real identity/source-purpose grants, encrypted isolated storage, disk/body/rate limits and independent assessment are activation gates.
Provider multipart/conditional upload and hosted network behavior remain unimplemented/unverified; the existing 8 MiB adapter is unchanged.
A matching header is not a malware or parser clearance. All uploads remain private quarantine.
Filesystem administrators remain trusted and local audit chains are not independently anchored.
No historical verification, rights clearance, public publication or operational research-record promotion.
